title: Frontend Developer
description: Master the art of building beautiful, interactive, and high-performance user interfaces. This roadmap takes you from internet fundamentals to modern frameworks like React and Next.js, teaching you how to architect applications that users love.

nodes.title: Internet Fundamentals
nodes.description: Understand how websites actually work before writing code. Learn HTTP, DNS, browsers, hosting, and how information travels across the internet. This foundation makes every future topic easier to understand and debug.

nodes.title: HTML5 & Semantic Web
nodes.description: Don't just throw <div> tags everywhere. Learn how to structure documents meaningfully using semantic HTML. This ensures your websites are accessible to screen readers, perform well in search engines (SEO), and are easier to maintain.

nodes.title: Modern CSS & Layouts
nodes.description: Stop guessing why your elements aren't aligning. Master Flexbox and CSS Grid to confidently build any layout. You'll also learn variables, transitions, and animations to bring your interfaces to life without sacrificing performance.

nodes.title: Responsive Web Design
nodes.description: Don't just make pages look good on your laptop. Learn media queries, fluid typography, and responsive layouts so your applications work beautifully across phones, tablets, and massive desktop monitors.

nodes.title: JavaScript Core
nodes.description: JavaScript is the engine of the web. Move beyond basic syntax to understand closures, prototypes, asynchronous programming (Promises/async-await), and the DOM. This sets you apart from framework-only developers.

nodes.title: Version Control (Git & GitHub)
nodes.description: Professional development is a team sport. Learn how to track changes, create branches, resolve merge conflicts, and collaborate using pull requests. This is the absolute standard for working in any tech company.

nodes.title: Package Managers & Bundlers
nodes.description: Modern apps use hundreds of external libraries. Learn how to manage dependencies with npm/yarn, and understand how bundlers like Vite and Webpack compile your code for production.

nodes.title: React.js Fundamentals
nodes.description: Dive into the industry's most popular UI library. Learn how to break UIs into reusable components, manage state, and handle side effects with Hooks. You'll shift your mindset from imperative DOM manipulation to declarative rendering.

nodes.title: State Management & Architecture
nodes.description: As your app grows, passing props becomes a nightmare. Learn how to structure global state using context, Redux, or Zustand. Understanding when NOT to use global state is just as important.

nodes.title: Next.js & Server-Side Rendering
nodes.description: React alone can be slow to load and bad for SEO. Learn Next.js to pre-render your pages on the server. You'll understand routing, SSR, SSG, and API routes, taking your apps to enterprise-grade performance.

nodes.title: CSS Frameworks & Tailwind
nodes.description: Writing vanilla CSS for every project takes too long. Master utility-first CSS with Tailwind to rapidly build responsive, consistent designs without leaving your HTML, which is a massive productivity boost.

nodes.title: Testing (Jest & Playwright)
nodes.description: Don't test your code by endlessly clicking around. Learn how to write unit tests for your functions and end-to-end tests for your user flows, giving you the confidence to refactor code without breaking the app.

title: Backend Developer
description: Become the architect behind the scenes. Learn how to design robust databases, build secure APIs, manage servers, and scale applications to handle millions of requests smoothly.

nodes.title: Internet & Networking
nodes.description: Backend engineering starts with the network. Deep dive into HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/UDP, WebSockets, and how browsers communicate with servers. You must understand what happens when a user types a URL.

nodes.title: Backend Language (Node.js/Python/Go)
nodes.description: Choose a primary weapon. Learn how your chosen language handles memory, concurrency, and package management. Understanding the event loop in Node or goroutines in Go is critical for writing performant servers.

nodes.title: Relational Databases (SQL)
nodes.description: Data is the core of any application. Learn how to design normalized schemas, write complex joins, and use indexes efficiently. Postgres or MySQL will be your bread and butter.

nodes.title: NoSQL Databases
nodes.description: Not all data fits neatly into tables. Understand document stores like MongoDB and key-value stores like Redis. You need to know exactly when to choose NoSQL over SQL based on your data access patterns.

nodes.title: RESTful API Design
nodes.description: Your API is how the world interacts with your system. Learn how to design predictable, resource-based endpoints, handle proper HTTP status codes, and paginate large datasets.

nodes.title: Authentication & Security
nodes.description: Don't let user data get stolen. Master secure password hashing (bcrypt), session management, JWTs, OAuth2, and how to defend against common attacks like SQL injection and CSRF.

nodes.title: Caching Strategies
nodes.description: Database queries are slow. Learn how to implement in-memory caching with Redis to serve responses instantly. You'll also learn the hard part: cache invalidation.

nodes.title: Message Brokers & Async Processing
nodes.description: Never block the main thread for a slow task. Learn how to offload heavy workloads (like sending emails or processing images) to background workers using RabbitMQ or Kafka.

nodes.title: Docker & Containerization
nodes.description: Stop saying 'It works on my machine'. Learn how to package your application and its dependencies into isolated containers so it runs identically in development, testing, and production.

nodes.title: CI/CD Pipelines
nodes.description: Automate your deployments. Learn how to set up GitHub Actions to run your tests and deploy your code every time you push to the repository, eliminating manual deployment errors.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Bridge the gap between frontend and backend. Learn the entire lifecycle of web applications, from designing the database schema to deploying the final user interface.

nodes.title: HTML, CSS & JavaScript Fundamentals
nodes.description: Before touching a framework, build a strong foundation. Master the trio of web languages, focusing heavily on ES6+ JavaScript, DOM manipulation, and responsive design principles.

nodes.title: Frontend Framework (React)
nodes.description: Learn how modern UIs are built. Understand component lifecycles, state management, and declarative rendering to build complex, interactive single-page applications.

nodes.title: Server-Side Fundamentals (Node.js)
nodes.description: Take JavaScript to the server. Learn how to handle file systems, streams, and basic HTTP routing without relying on a framework, giving you a deep understanding of server mechanics.

nodes.title: Building APIs (Express)
nodes.description: Connect your frontend to real data. Learn how to create RESTful APIs, manage middleware, parse incoming requests, and return structured JSON responses to the client.

nodes.title: Database Integration (SQL & ORMs)
nodes.description: Stop storing data in variables. Learn how to design a relational database schema and use an ORM like Prisma or Sequelize to safely query and mutate data from your server.

nodes.title: User Authentication
nodes.description: Secure your application end-to-end. Learn how to register users, hash passwords securely, and implement cookie-based or token-based authentication flows that work across frontend and backend.

nodes.title: Full Stack Meta-Frameworks (Next.js)
nodes.description: Blur the lines between client and server. Learn how to build applications where the frontend and backend live in the same codebase, utilizing Server Components and Server Actions.

nodes.title: Deployment & Hosting
nodes.description: Get your app on the internet. Learn how to provision a database on a cloud provider, deploy your server on platforms like Render or AWS, and host your frontend on Vercel.

title: Mobile App Developer
description: Build native applications that live in users pockets. Learn modern mobile development using React Native or Flutter to create high-performance apps for both iOS and Android.

nodes.title: Programming Foundations
nodes.description: Master JavaScript (for React Native) or Dart (for Flutter). A strong grasp of the underlying language's object-oriented and functional features is critical before diving into mobile UI paradigms.

nodes.title: Mobile UI Layouts
nodes.description: Mobile screens are small and wildly varied. Learn how to use Flexbox or layout widgets to create responsive designs that adapt perfectly from an iPhone Mini to a large Android tablet.

nodes.title: Navigation & Routing
nodes.description: Websites use URLs; apps use stacks. Understand stack, tab, and drawer navigation paradigms. Managing the back-stack correctly prevents users from getting trapped in your app.

nodes.title: State & Data Fetching
nodes.description: Mobile apps must handle spotty network connections gracefully. Learn how to manage local state, fetch API data, and cache responses for offline viewing so the app feels instantly responsive.

nodes.title: Device Hardware & APIs
nodes.description: Apps are powerful because they have hardware access. Learn how to request user permissions and integrate the camera, GPS, accelerometer, and local file storage.

nodes.title: Push Notifications
nodes.description: Keep users engaged. Learn how to configure Apple APNs and Firebase Cloud Messaging to send reliable, targeted notifications to users devices even when the app is closed.

nodes.title: Animations & Gestures
nodes.description: A static app feels dead. Learn how to implement fluid transitions, swipe-to-delete gestures, and micro-interactions that make your application feel premium and native.

nodes.title: App Store Deployment
nodes.description: The final hurdle. Understand the complex processes of signing certificates, provisioning profiles, and navigating the review guidelines to successfully publish to the App Store and Google Play.

title: Game Developer
description: Turn your imagination into playable realities. Learn game engines, 3D math, physics, and scripting to build immersive, interactive experiences for PC, console, or mobile.

nodes.title: C# or C++ Foundations
nodes.description: Games require performance. Master object-oriented programming, memory management, and data structures in a strictly typed language. This is the bedrock of game logic.

nodes.title: Game Engine Architecture
nodes.description: Understand the game loop. Learn how Unity or Unreal Engine processes inputs, updates game state, and renders frames at 60fps, and how to optimize your code to fit within that window.

nodes.title: 2D & 3D Math Fundamentals
nodes.description: Don't let the math scare you. You must understand vectors, quaternions (for rotation), and matrices to move objects, calculate bullet trajectories, and determine lines of sight.

nodes.title: Physics & Collision Detection
nodes.description: Stop things from falling through the floor. Learn how to use rigidbodies, colliders, and raycasts to create realistic physics interactions and trigger events when objects touch.

nodes.title: Animation Systems
nodes.description: Bring characters to life. Learn about state machines, blend trees, and skeletal animation to seamlessly transition a character from walking, to running, to jumping.

nodes.title: UI & Input Systems
nodes.description: Games need menus and controls. Learn how to build responsive health bars, inventories, and pause menus, while supporting multiple input devices like keyboards, mice, and gamepads.

nodes.title: AI & Pathfinding
nodes.description: Make your enemies smart. Implement NavMeshes for pathfinding so NPCs can navigate around obstacles, and use Finite State Machines to give them behaviors like patrol, chase, and attack.

nodes.title: Audio Implementation
nodes.description: Sound is half the experience. Learn how to manage audio sources, spatial 3D sound, and audio mixing to create immersive soundscapes and satisfying impact effects.

nodes.title: Optimization & Profiling
nodes.description: Find out why your game is lagging. Use profiling tools to identify CPU bottlenecks, reduce draw calls, and manage memory effectively so your game runs smoothly on low-end hardware.
